name: 38340 · Henderson, TN
findings: ZIP 38340 (Henderson) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38340 (Henderson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
